summary: Reworks program/subscription API routes for the mobile app (mobile-compatible session reading, inlined action logic), adds logged-in /api/user/preferences backed by new User.onboardingPreferences column (no migration), scroll tweak.

statements.why: Preferences route requires a session (401 otherwise) and only touches own user; ownership checks kept.

statements.text: New server code that shows and updates the logged-in person's own account. /api/user/preferences
statements.why: GET/PUT of session user's own onboardingPreferences; fixes old 'lists users' wording.

statements.text: The agent changed the program enroll, program progress, session progress complete/start and revenuecat sync status parts of your server in ways plain can't describe yet.
Users now also store the onboarding preferences.
The agent also changed workout-session-sets.tsx in a way plain can't describe yet.
Update your database: run `npx prisma migrate dev` (live: migrate deploy). No migration was created.
statements.why: No migration exists; Prisma user queries would fail without the column.

misses.what: Commit message ('server port variable') doesn't describe the change; it changes how logins are read on 6 mobile API routes.
Enrolling via API no longer sends EnrolledInProgram analytics or revalidates the program page.
